doc: Rules that decide which Earth windows are in the search pool. ONE place for every rule; pipelines read it, nothing hard-codes it. Decided 2026-11-14 (Mario: the Arctic goes inside the analysis; Claude proposed the numbers below). The measure, sigma and tie thresholds stay frozen (config/measure.json v1.3, data/derived/validation/noise_v1.3.json).

bands.built_by: pipelines/pool_add_arctic.py (rows pool_02001.., id = 2000 + arctic probe number; probe_id kept)
bands.why: NASADEM ends at 60N; ESA WorldCover ends at 84N. Copernicus GLO-30 is the only open 30 m DEM there. The tie threshold IS the p95 of D(NASADEM, Copernicus), so mixing the two sensors is inside the stated noise.

bare_share_disk: full 4 km radius disk around the centre (not the +-5 px coarse window, which narrows in km at high latitude)
ice_rule_why: Rehearsable ground is rock or soil, not an ice sheet: windows with 20% or more WorldCover class 70 (snow and ice) in the 4 km disk are kept out of the pool and listed with their reason. Check 2026-11-14: half of the Arctic windows that closed Mars gaps were ice sheets (docs/verification/arctic_ice/).
known_analog_list: config/regions.json role known_analog (same list and distance as the NASADEM pool)
